decision.utility: irrigate: stressDaysAvoided - price; do not irrigate: 0

meta.caseDefinition: one case = site x soil x coffee year x decision day (30/60/90) x shade configuration; coffee year Y = 1 Nov Y to 31 Oct Y+1; test cases of different shades/soils at the same site-year share the weather

ptcMlp.recipe: fit_network of scripts/emulator/train_mlp.py (Adam 1e-3, batch 256, patience 10 on 2017-2018), N_OUT = 1

meta.randomStreamNote: The recommender was trained by the evolution strategy implemented in PyTorch on the GPU (scripts/coffee/train_es.py). Its random stream is torch's CUDA generator seeded with 17/29/43, not the mulberry32 stream of the JS recommender; design and distributions are the same, the numbers differ.

jsEsBenchmark.note: JS, one thread; validation scoring of the champion not included (adds ~1 % of the work)

meta.noMargin: No yield and no money: coffee has no FAO Ky. The judge is our simulator.
